title: Provider adapter SPI and independent evidence channels
summary: Dev6 SocialAdapter SPI supports provider discovery, dispatch, authenticated inbound acceptance and remote delivery reconciliation as independent operations.
invariants: Adapter registration must never confer brand publishing or advertising privileges.
dispatch returns provider acknowledgment, not verified remote delivery.
Inbound proof and reconciliation proof are separate verification domains; the inert test adapter denies both.
Platform adapters must use API Client for transport, Secret Broker for secrets and existing Identity/Institutional Policy for governance.
Commercial API availability and platform-specific permissions must be validated before a live adapter can be declared qualified.
